summary: A wide treatment menu and clear starting prices are strengths, but builder text, unfinished headings and no on page booking appear to cost you bookings.

findings.problem: The newsletter block shows builder text: 'This newsletter signup form needs a storage option. Edit the block and enter a storage location via the Storage tab.'
findings.cost: Leftover editor text makes the clinic look unfinished.

findings.problem: Explore Our Clinic and Canadian Leader for are followed by empty bullets, Canadian Leader for never says what the clinic leads in, and Take Advantage of This Treatment With Us has no content.
findings.cost: Unfinished headings undermine a bold claim.

findings.problem: The page shows 'Palette-Rich Plasma(PRP)', 'Bela Facial', and skin lesion removal pages under several different addresses.
findings.cost: Typos and duplicate pages weaken trust and search ranking.
findings.fix: Proofread copy and one page per treatment.

findings.problem: Booking runs only through an outside link, the Login Account links go to #, and no testimonials, reviews or named dermatologists appear.
findings.cost: Patients cannot book or check proof on the page.
findings.fix: An on page booking path, reviews and named practitioners.

redesign: Finished sections and a working newsletter signup.
An on page booking path with WhatsApp.
Reviews, named practitioners and one page per treatment.
